definitions.explanation: A one-sided tendency or prejudice in thinking, reporting, or attitudes. Often used critically to point out unfairness or lack of objectivity.

examples.japanese: {偏向|へんこう}⟦{報道|ほうどう}→報道：04438_houdou⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{批判|ひはん}→批判：03580_hihan⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: It was criticized as biased reporting.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦メディア→メディア：11165_media⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{政治的|せいじてき}→政治的：05684_seijiteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{偏向|へんこう}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: That media outlet is politically biased.

examples.japanese: {偏向|へんこう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{見方|みかた}→見方：10072_mikata⟧⟦ではなく→ではなく：09578_dehanaku⟧、⟦{多角的|たかくてき}→多角的：18710_takakuteki⟧な⟦{視点|してん}→視点：03187_shiten⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{物事|ものごと}→物事：00291_monogoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{判断|はんだん}→判断：03571_handan⟧すべきだ。
examples.english: One should judge matters from multiple perspectives, not from a biased viewpoint.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{偏|へん}→偏：26560_hen⟧ (one-sided, biased) + {向|こう} (direction, inclination). Carries a negative connotation — it implies that something is unfairly tilted in one direction. Most commonly encountered in media criticism.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {偏向|へんこう}⟦{報道|ほうどう}→報道：04438_houdou⟧: biased reporting
- {偏向|へんこう}⟦{教育|きょういく}→教育：01313_kyouiku⟧: biased education; ideological indoctrination
- {偏向|へんこう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧: a biased opinion
- {偏向|へんこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be biased; to lean

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{偏見|へんけん}→偏見：06025_henken⟧: prejudice (about personal beliefs and attitudes toward people)
- ⟦バイアス→バイアス：11491_baiasu⟧: bias (loanword; common in academic/technical contexts)
- ⟦{先入観|せんにゅうかん}→先入観：07312_sennyuukan⟧: preconceived notion (emphasis on pre-existing assumptions)
